axioms.explanation: Collecting and studying domain knowledge never automatically authorizes or constitutes model training data.
Completing a fine-tuning or distillation run proves only that optimization finished — never that capability improved.
Internal experimental scores or guarded test harnesses do not constitute independent capability certification.
Internal readiness does not guarantee public deployment, API access, or open-weight distribution.

lifecycle.name: Research
lifecycle.summary: Systematic technical study across FDS's 15 core engineering, scientific, gaming, and creative disciplines.

lifecycle.name: Source Verification
lifecycle.summary: Provenance auditing, primary-source grounding, license review, and strict separation of reference material from training corpora.

lifecycle.name: Engineering Experiments
lifecycle.summary: Executable prototypes, micro-benchmarks, and empirical software/simulation experiments testing concrete hypotheses.

lifecycle.name: Knowledge Retrieval
lifecycle.summary: Structured indexing, canonical schemas, and retrieval-augmented grounding (RAG) for auditable citation.

lifecycle.name: Dataset Eligibility
lifecycle.summary: Explicit rights clearance, contamination screening, deduplication, and quality filtering prior to any model training.

lifecycle.name: Controlled Training
lifecycle.summary: Reproducible SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, or multi-teacher distillation runs with logged hyperparameters and provenance manifests.

lifecycle.name: Independent Evaluation
lifecycle.summary: Raw vs. guarded testing on isolated holdout tasks with documented test counts, baselines, and uncertainty.

lifecycle.name: Capability Certification
lifecycle.summary: Final release-readiness gate verifying limitations, safety boundaries, and truthful public model-card disclosure.

divisions.name: Universal Gaming
divisions.focus: Game design grammar, player assistance, mechanics systems, and cross-genre gameplay intelligence.

divisions.name: Game Engineering
divisions.focus: Engine internals, C++/C# gameplay architectures, memory layouts, networking, and automated verification.

divisions.name: Software Engineering
divisions.focus: Repository-scale reasoning, multi-agent orchestration, diff verification, and fail-closed developer tooling.

divisions.name: Artificial Intelligence
divisions.focus: Specialist post-training, LoRA/QLoRA efficiency, multi-teacher distillation, and collective intelligence convergence.

divisions.name: Anime & Manga
divisions.focus: Panel pacing, visual storytelling grammar, canonical continuity tracking, and production terminology.

divisions.name: Animation
divisions.focus: Keyframe timing, skeletal rigging workflows, motion principles, and tool-assisted animation pipelines.

divisions.name: Cinematic Production
divisions.focus: Camera choreography, lighting direction, scene blocking, storyboard structure, and editing cadence.

divisions.name: Graphics & Rendering
divisions.focus: PBR materials, shader programming, real-time lighting budgets, and GPU frame profiling.

divisions.name: Physics & Mathematics
divisions.focus: Classical mechanics, collision geometry, kinematics bounds, numerical stability, and probabilistic uncertainty.

divisions.name: Technical Art
divisions.focus: Procedural environments, Blender-to-engine asset validation, LOD automation, and UV/material pipelines.

divisions.name: Narrative Development
divisions.focus: Long-form story bibles, character consistency, regional historical grounding, and branching world continuity.

divisions.name: Audio Engineering
divisions.focus: Interactive soundscapes, spatial audio architecture, dialogue pacing, and real-time mixing cues.

divisions.name: Simulation
divisions.focus: Deterministic multi-entity combat and world-state simulations with reproducible scenario parameters.

divisions.name: Evaluation
divisions.focus: Holdout benchmark design, raw vs. guarded scoring protocols, baseline fairness, and statistical confidence reporting.

divisions.name: Original Engineering Experiments
divisions.focus: First-party runtime benchmarks, routing reliability tests, and automated CI/browser verification harnesses.
